unmapped_findings: Nb addition refines austenite grain size (as-cast: 18 μm in 0.02Nb steel vs 9 μm in 0.04Nb steel).
Nb doping raises κ-carbide formation energy (Fe24Al8C8: 0.891 eV; Fe23NbAl8C8: 2.826 eV; Fe24Al7NbC8: 1.453 eV), suppressing κ-carbide growth and coarsening.
The 0.04Nb steel shows ≈71 MPa higher yield strength than the 0.02Nb steel, mainly from additional fine grain strengthening and dislocation strengthening.
No coarsened intergranular κ-carbides were detected in either steel variant after aging at 723–823 K.
